title: Measuring Curtain Fabric
situation: A customer asks a shop assistant to measure the length and height of fabric needed for curtains.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa shaqaale dukaan ka codsanaya inuu cabbiro dhererka iyo joogga dharka daahyada loogu baahan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I need fabric for curtains.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay dhar daahyo loogu talagalay.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: What length do you need?
dialogue.somali: Dherer intee le'eg ayaad u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Please measure two metres.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan cabbir laba mitir.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: All right. Can you add ten centimetres?
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Toban sentimitir ma ku dari karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, please add ten centimetres.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan ku dar toban sentimitir.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: How wide is the window?
dialogue.somali: Daaqaddu ballac ahaan intee le'eg tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It is wide, but the height is one metre.
dialogue.somali: Way ballaaran tahay, laakiin jooggu waa hal mitir.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Good. I will cut two metres and ten centimetres.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Waxaan jarayaa laba mitir iyo toban sentimitir.

title: Buying Fruit by Weight
situation: A customer buys fruit at a market and asks the seller to weigh one kilogram, then reduce it because the bag is heavy.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa suuqa ka iibsanaya miro, wuxuuna iibiyaha ka codsanayaa inuu miisaamo hal kiilo kadibna yareeyo maadaama bacdu culus tahay.
key_phrases: Please take out two hundred grams.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can you weigh these mangoes?
dialogue.somali: Cambahan ma ii miisaami kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes. They weigh one kilogram.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Waxay miisaankoodu yahay hal kiilo.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: That bag feels heavy.
dialogue.somali: Bacdaasi waxay u muuqataa mid culus.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: I can make the weight lower.
dialogue.somali: Miisaanka waan dhimi karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Please take out two hundred grams.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan ka saar laba boqol oo garaam.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Now the weight is eight hundred grams.
dialogue.somali: Hadda miisaanku waa siddeed boqol oo garaam.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Now it is light enough.
dialogue.somali: Hadda way igu filan tahay oo fudud tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Would you like a smaller bag?
dialogue.somali: Ma rabtaa bac ka yar?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, please. This one is easier to carry.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan. Tan way fududahay in la qaado.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Here you are.
dialogue.somali: Waa kuwan.

title: Measuring Liquid Medicine
somali_title: Daawo dareere ah oo la cabbirayo
situation: A customer asks a pharmacist how much liquid medicine to pour into a small measuring container.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa farmashiiste weydiinaya inta daawo dareere ah ee lagu shubayo weel yar oo cabbir ah.
key_phrases: How much liquid should I take?
Is that less than a litre?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How much liquid should I take?
dialogue.somali: Intee daawo dareere ah ayaan qaataa?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: The volume is five millilitres.
dialogue.somali: Muggu waa shan milliliter.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Is that less than a litre?
dialogue.somali: Taasi ma ka yar tahay hal liter?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Yes, one litre is much more.
dialogue.somali: Haa, hal liter aad buu uga badan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How do I measure five millilitres?
dialogue.somali: Sideen u cabbiraa shan milliliter?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Use this small container.
dialogue.somali: Isticmaal weelkan yar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Should I fill it to the first line?
dialogue.somali: Ma ilaa xariiqda koowaad ayaan buuxiyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Yes, the first line shows five millilitres.
dialogue.somali: Haa, xariiqda koowaad waxay muujisaa shan milliliter.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do I need water with it?
dialogue.somali: Biyo ma u baahanahay inaan la qaato?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: You may drink water after the medicine.
dialogue.somali: Daawada kadib biyo waad cabbi kartaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Thank you. The measurement is clear.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Cabbirku wuu ii caddahay.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Good. Take only that amount each time.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Mar kasta qaado qiyaastaas oo keliya.

title: Checking a Child's Temperature
situation: A parent calls a nurse after checking a child's temperature and asks whether the Celsius reading means a fever.
somali_situation: Waalid ayaa kalkaaliso wacaya kadib marka uu hubiyo heerkulka ilmaha, wuxuuna weydiinayaa in cabbirka Celsius uu muujinayo qandho.
key_phrases: It is thirty-eight point five degrees Celsius.
Call us again if the temperature rises.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Hello, I checked my child's temperature.
dialogue.somali: Salaan, waxaan hubiyey heerkulka ilmahayga.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: What does the thermometer say?
dialogue.somali: Heerkulbeeggu muxuu sheegayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: It is thirty-eight point five degrees Celsius.
dialogue.somali: Waa siddeed iyo soddon dhibic shan darajo Celsius.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: That sounds like a fever.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waxay u egtahay qandho.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: She says she feels cold.
dialogue.somali: Waxay leedahay qabow bay dareemaysaa.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: That can happen with a fever.
dialogue.somali: Taasi way dhici kartaa marka qandho jirto.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Is the room too cold?
dialogue.somali: Qolku ma aad buu u qabow yahay?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Keep the room warm, but not hot.
dialogue.somali: Qolka diirimaad ka dhig, laakiin ha ka dhigin kulul.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Should I check the temperature again later?
dialogue.somali: Miyaan heerkulka mar kale hubiyaa goor dambe?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Yes, check it again in one hour.
dialogue.somali: Haa, mar kale hubi hal saac kadib.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: What if it goes higher?
dialogue.somali: Haddii ay ka sii kacdo maxaan sameeyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Call us again if the temperature rises.
dialogue.somali: Mar kale na soo wac haddii heerkulku kaco.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Should I write down the degree each time?
dialogue.somali: Mar kasta ma qoriyaa darajada?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Yes, write down each Celsius reading.
dialogue.somali: Haa, qor cabbir kasta oo Celsius ah.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Thank you. I know what to watch now.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Hadda waan garanayaa waxa aan fiirinayo.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: You're welcome. Call sooner if she seems worse.
dialogue.somali: Waad mudan tahay. Si degdeg ah u wac haddii ay ka sii darto.

title: Asking How Far the Clinic Is
somali_title: Fogaan rug caafimaad loo jiro oo la weydiinayo
situation: A visitor asks a local person how far the clinic is and whether it is near enough to walk.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa qof deegaanka ah weydiinaya inta rugta caafimaadka loo jiro iyo haddii ay dhowdahay in lug lagu tago.
key_phrases: It is approximately one kilometre away.
Is it near enough to walk?

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Excuse me, how far is the clinic?
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, rugta caafimaadka intee loo jiraa?

dialogue.speaker: Local Person
dialogue.english: It is approximately one kilometre away.
dialogue.somali: Qiyaastii hal kiiloomitir bay u jirtaa.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is it near enough to walk?
dialogue.somali: Ma dhowdahay oo lug ma lagu tagi karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Local Person
dialogue.english: Yes, it is not far.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fog ma aha.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Which way should I go?
dialogue.somali: Jidkee ayaan maraa?

dialogue.speaker: Local Person
dialogue.english: Walk straight for ten minutes.
dialogue.somali: Toban daqiiqo si toos ah u soco.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: So the distance is short?
dialogue.somali: Markaa fogaantu way gaaban tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Local Person
dialogue.english: Yes, but take water if it is hot.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin biyo qaado haddii ay kulushahay.

title: Checking a Clothing Size
situation: A customer compares small, medium, and large clothing sizes with a shop assistant before choosing a shirt that fits.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa shaqaale dukaan la barbar dhigaya cabbirrada dharka ee yar, dhexe, iyo weyn ka hor inta uusan dooran shaati ku habboon.
key_phrases: I need the right clothing size.
Do you have a large size too?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I need the right clothing size.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay cabbirka dharka ee saxda ah.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: What size do you usually wear?
dialogue.somali: Cabbirkee ayaad badanaa xirataa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Medium, but sometimes small.
dialogue.somali: Dhexe, laakiin mararka qaar yar.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Small may be too tight.
dialogue.somali: Yar waxaa laga yaabaa inuu aad kuu ciriiri noqdo.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Medium should fit better.
dialogue.somali: Dhexe ayaa si fiican kuugu habboonaan kara.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Do you have a large size too?
dialogue.somali: Cabbir weynna ma haysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, but large may be loose.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin weyn waxaa laga yaabaa inuu dabacsanaado.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Can I try the medium shirt?
dialogue.somali: Shirtka cabbirka dhexe ma cabbiri karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Of course. The fitting room is open.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Qolka cabbirku wuu furan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: This size fits well.
dialogue.somali: Cabbirkan si fiican ayuu ii le'eg yahay.

title: Finding a Comfortable Shoe Size
somali_title: Cabbir kabo oo raaxo leh oo la helayo
situation: A customer tries on shoes and asks for a half size because one pair is tight and another is loose.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa kabo cabbiraya, wuxuuna codsanayaa nus cabbir sababtoo ah hal lammaane wuu ciriiri yahay mid kalena wuu dabacsan yahay.
key_phrases: Do you have a half size bigger?
This pair feels loose at the heel.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I need shoes for work.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay kabo shaqo.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: What is your shoe size?
dialogue.somali: Cabbirka kabahaagu waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Usually size nine.
dialogue.somali: Badanaa cabbir sagaal.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Try this pair first.
dialogue.somali: Marka hore lammaanahan cabbir.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: This shoe feels tight.
dialogue.somali: Kabtan wuu i ciriirinayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Do you have a half size bigger?
dialogue.somali: Ma haysaa nus cabbir ka weyn?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, here is nine and a half.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa kan sagaal iyo bar.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: This pair feels loose at the heel.
dialogue.somali: Lammaanahan ciribta ayuu ka dabacsan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Then try the wide size nine.
dialogue.somali: Markaa cabbirka sagaalka ballaaran cabbir.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: These shoes are comfortable.
dialogue.somali: Kabahan waa raaxo.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Good. They should not rub when you walk.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Waa inaysan ku xoqin markaad socoto.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: I will take this shoe size.
dialogue.somali: Cabbirkan kabaha ayaan qaadanayaa.

title: Following a Recipe Measurement
situation: A learner cooks with a friend and checks teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, grams, and half amounts in a recipe.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa saaxiib la karinaya, wuxuuna hubinayaa qaaddo yar, qaaddo weyn, koob, garaam, iyo nus qiyaas oo ku jira cunto-karis.
key_phrases: How many grams of flour do we need?
Is that a teaspoon or a tablespoon?
Use half a teaspoon of salt.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: How many grams of flour do we need?
dialogue.somali: Immisa garaam oo bur ah ayaan u baahanahay?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: We need two hundred grams.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay laba boqol oo garaam.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Should I add the milk now?
dialogue.somali: Caanaha hadda ma ku daraa?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Yes, add one cup of milk.
dialogue.somali: Haa, ku dar hal koob oo caano ah.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Is that a teaspoon or a tablespoon?
dialogue.somali: Taasi ma qaaddo yar baa mise qaaddo weyn?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: For sugar, use a tablespoon.
dialogue.somali: Sonkorta, isticmaal qaaddo weyn.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: And for salt?
dialogue.somali: Cusbada se?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Use half a teaspoon of salt.
dialogue.somali: Isticmaal nus qaaddo yar oo cusbo ah.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: I almost used half a tablespoon.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan ku sigtay inaan isticmaalo nus qaaddo weyn.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: That would make the food too salty.
dialogue.somali: Taasi cuntada aad bay cusbo ugu badin lahayd.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: These cooking measurements matter.
dialogue.somali: Cabbirradan cunto-karintu muhiim bay yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: They do, especially with baking.
dialogue.somali: Haa, gaar ahaan marka wax la dubayo.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: What should I mix next?
dialogue.somali: Maxaan xigta isku daraa?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Mix the flour, milk, sugar, and salt slowly.
dialogue.somali: Si tartiib ah isku dar burka, caanaha, sonkorta, iyo cusbada.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: I will read each measurement before I add it.
dialogue.somali: Cabbir kasta waan akhrin doonaa ka hor inta aanan ku darin.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Good. Then the recipe will turn out right.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Markaa cunto-karisku si sax ah ayuu u soo bixi doonaa.

title: Asking How Long a Class Lasts
somali_title: Fasal inta uu socdo oo la weydiinayo
situation: A student asks a receptionist about the duration of a class and the deadline for arriving.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa soo-dhoweeye weydiinaya muddada fasalku socdo iyo waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee la imaan karo.
key_phrases: How long does the class last?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: How long does the class last?
dialogue.somali: Fasalku intee buu socdaa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: The duration is one hour.
dialogue.somali: Muddadu waa hal saac.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Is there a ten-minute break?
dialogue.somali: Ma jiraa nasasho toban daqiiqo ah?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Yes, after thirty minutes.
dialogue.somali: Haa, soddon daqiiqo kadib.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: What is the deadline for arriving?
dialogue.somali: Waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee la imaan karo waa goorma?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: The deadline is nine o'clock.
dialogue.somali: Waqtiga ugu dambeeya waa sagaalka.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will arrive on time.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Waqtiga ayaan ku imaan doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Good. The class starts at nine fifteen.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Fasalku wuxuu bilaabmaa sagaal iyo rubuc.
